description: This file defines a custom exception class KpiServiceException for the OrangeHRM Performance module, specifically in the Exception namespace. It includes a method to generate a specific error message when the minimum rating exceeds the maximum rating.

classes.name: KpiServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class for KPI Service errors within the OrangeHRM Performance module, extending the base Exception class. It provides a static method to generate an exception with a specific message related to rating validation.

methods.name: minGreaterThanMax
methods.description: A static factory method that creates a new instance of KpiServiceException with a message indicating that the minimum rating should be less than the maximum rating.

calls: new self("Minimum rating should be less than Maximum rating")
